model_output:
```sql
WITH garden_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-76.638575, 39.300016), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
area_avg_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(ST_Value(r.rast, 1)) AS avg_elevation
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM garden_geom)::geometry)
),
garden_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(r.rast, 1) AS elevation
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM garden_geom)::geometry)
    AND ST_Clip(r.rast, (SELECT geom FROM garden_geom)::geometry, TRUE) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  'Memory Garden' AS garden_name,
  (SELECT elevation FROM garden_elevation) AS garden_elevation,
  (SELECT avg_elevation FROM area_avg_elevation) AS area_avg_elevation
WHERE 
  (SELECT elevation FROM garden_elevation) > (SELECT avg_elevation FROM area_avg_elevation);
```
